title: TLS verification weakened (ssleay) — review required
description: ssleay weakens TLS verification: SSL_verify_modes*(?:=>|=)s*(?:0|SSL_VERIFY_NONE). The connection then trusts attackers' certificates. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or restores verification.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of environment.
